releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.9 (Build 76):
• Split Sector Calorie Architecture: 5 meal sectors (Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks, Dinner, Night Canteen) with slot-based chromatic arcs and curved radial labels.
• Fluid Droplet Navigation: Water droplet sliding pill indicator on the floating navigation bar with spring-physics transitions.
• Auto-Expanding Chat Viewport: Multi-line responsive textarea in Luna AI and overflow-scrolling table/code layouts.
• Borderless OLED Surfaces: Complete elimination of white card outlines across hero and dashboard cards for seamless dark aesthetics.
• Automated Hydration Notifications: Periodic 30-minute smart hydration reminders without manual logging friction.
